propositions: Batching multiple candidate digests into a single judge call reduces call count from 2N to 2*ceil(N/batch), cutting token usage by ~48% on a 6-candidate corpus versus pre-8415 baseline.
Hoisting the batch protocol description into the system prompt adds ~436 tokens, pushing the cacheable prefix from 873 to 1,337 tokens and crossing the 1024-token minimum cache threshold.
Verdicts must be demultiplexed by candidate label rather than position; missing or unknown entries abstain only for the affected candidate without propagating errors.
Batching introduces systematic relation-label shifts (5/6 divergences move conservatively away from surfacing; true-positive injection confirms no cross-contamination of findings).
The change stacks on ticket 8415 and delivers both call-count reduction (arithmetic guarantee) and prefix caching (measured empirical outcome).
